about_the_game:
Project: V.I.R.A. is a tactical co-op first-person extraction shooter set in an alternate 1990s plagued by a deadly outbreak. You are a specialized voice-integrated agent unit sent into infected zones to recover valuable tech and lost intelligence for remaining survivors underground.

Every operation is a gamble: enter procedurally generated missions, scavenge what you can, complete objectives under pressure, and fight your way out to the extraction point before it is too late...

  • Co-Op Focused Gameplay – Work as a 4-player squad with built-in voice chat and proximity audio. Communication isn't optional—it’s survival.

  • Procedurally Generated Missions – No two deployments are the same. Environments, enemies, and objectives shift with every run.

  • High-Stakes Extraction Loop – Loot, fight, complete objectives, and extract—or lose it all.

  • Zombies, Mutants & Worse – Face a range of infected threats in various locations.

  • Alternate 90s Retro-Futurism – CRT monitors, analog tech, and VHS grain meet military sci-fi in a bleak reimagining of the past.

  • Gear Management & Progression – Choose your loadout wisely: guns, gear, ammunition, medical supplies, gadgets, and upgrades to make to the end.

Will Project: V.I.R.A. be fatal or rebirth for humankind is up to you.

The virus doesn’t wait. Neither do the things that crawl in the dark. Suit up, sync comms, and make every run count in Project: V.I.R.A..

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense violence, gore, and disturbing imagery. Players will encounter graphic depictions of blood, dismemberment, undead enemies, and other unsettling content throughout gameplay. The game also includes strong language and dark atmospheric themes.
